subject: DI04000251

body.en:
Start with the situation

A lever arm may look thick but still fail at the boss fillet where moment and local stress are high.

Definition / principle

A bending moment produces tensile stress on one side and compressive stress on the opposite side of a section.

Understand why

In elementary elastic bending, stress varies linearly with distance from the neutral axis.

Application / illustration

Section orientation matters:turning a rectangular flat through90degrees changes its bending section modulus.

Common mistake / conditions

A shear force and local contact may accompany bending; pure-bending equations do not erase those checks.

Does a larger I always prove a safer lever?

No. Use Z about the correct axis and also check pin, boss, load path and service conditions.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Lever arm જાડો લાગે,પણ boss fillet પાસે moment,local stressથી fail થઈ શકે.

Definition / Principle

Bending moment sectionની એક બાજુ tensile,વિરુદ્ધ બાજુ compressive stress આપે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Elementary elastic bendingમાં stress neutral axisથી distance પ્રમાણે linearly બદલાય.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Section orientation મહત્વની:rectangular flat90degrees ફેરવતાં bending section modulus બદલાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Bending સાથે shear,local contact હોઈ શકે;pure-bending equationથી એ checks દૂર થતાં નથી.

વધુ Iથી Lever Safe સાબિત?

ના.Correct axisનો Z,pin,boss,load path,service conditions પણ જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use M/I=sigma/y=E/R for a suitable slender, linear-elastic beam model.

Understand why

M is moment at the section, I second moment of area about the bending axis, y distance from neutral axis, E elastic modulus, R curvature radius.

Plane sections remain plane; material behaviour is elastic and the section/geometry assumptions must be appropriate.

Maximum bending stress=M/Z, whereZ=I/c andc is the extreme-fibre distance.

Use normal-stress allowable for bending under the chosen criterion; check shear, deflection, notches and stability separately.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Suitable slender,linear-elastic beam modelમાં M/I=sigma/y=E/R લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

M sectionનું moment,I bending axis સામે second moment,y neutral axisથી distance,E elastic modulus,R curvature radius.

Plane sections plane રહે;material elastic હોય,section/geometry assumptions યોગ્ય હોવાં જોઈએ.

Maximum bending stress=M/Z;Z=I/c,c extreme-fibre distance.

Chosen criterion મુજબ normal-stress allowable લો;shear,deflection,notches,stability અલગ જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Section modulus measures bending resistance geometrically; units aremm³, notmm⁴.

Understand why

Rectangle about centroid axis parallel to widthb:I=bh³/12, Z=bh²/6.

Square sidea:Z=a³/6.Solid circular diameterd:Z=pi d³/32.

Hollow circular section:Z=pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)/(32Do).

I, T, L, C sections need the correct centroid, I and extreme distances; unsymmetrical sections may have different tensile/compressive extreme stresses.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Section modulus geometryથી bending resistance બતાવે;unit mm³ છે,mm⁴ નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Width bને parallel centroid axis માટે rectangle I=bh³/12,Z=bh²/6.

Square side a માટે Z=a³/6;solid circular d માટે Z=pi d³/32.

Hollow circular Z=pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)/(32Do).

I,T,L,C sectionsમાં correct centroid,I,extreme distances જોઈએ;unsymmetricalમાં tensile/compressive extremes જુદાં હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
Given and model

M1kNm=1000000Nmm, allowable80MPa, height h=2b.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Zrequired=M/sigma=1000000/80=12500mm³
  2. Since b=h/2, Z=h³/12; hmin=(12×12500)^(1/3)=53.1329mm
  3. Select b30, h60mm:Z=30×60²/6=18000mm³
  4. Bending stress=1000000/18000=55.5556MPa

Common mistake / conditions

If the30×60mm section is turned to h30, b60, Z drops to9000mm³ and stress becomes111.111MPa:orientation can change a pass to failure.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

M1kNm=1000000Nmm,allowable80MPa,height h=2b.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Zrequired=M/sigma=1000000/80=12500mm³
  2. Since b=h/2,Z=h³/12;hmin=(12×12500)^(1/3)=53.1329mm
  3. Select b30,h60mm:Z=30×60²/6=18000mm³
  4. Bending stress=1000000/18000=55.5556MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

30×60mmને h30,b60 ફેરવીએ તો Z9000mm³,stress111.111MPa થાય;orientationથી pass fail બની શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A lever rotates about a fulcrum; use perpendicular moment arms.

Understand why

ClassI:fulcrum between effort and load, as in suitable rocker/crowbar arrangements.

ClassII:load between fulcrum and effort, as in a wheelbarrow idealisation. ClassIII:effort between, as in many forceps-like mechanisms.

Equilibrium gives effort×effort arm=load×load arm for the appropriate force directions.

The pin reaction is the vector sum needed for force equilibrium; it is not automatically equal to the output load alone.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Lever fulcrum આસપાસ ફરે;perpendicular moment arms લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Class Iમાં fulcrum effort,load વચ્ચે;suitable rocker/crowbarમાં.

Class IIમાં load વચ્ચે,wheelbarrow idealisation;Class IIIમાં effort વચ્ચે,ઘણા forceps-like mechanismsમાં.

Appropriate directionsમાં effort×effort arm=load×load arm.

Pin reaction force equilibrium માટે vector sum છે;ફક્ત output load જેટલું આપમેળે નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Solve the FBD before choosing arm thickness or pin diameter.

Understand why

Find forces and the bending-moment distribution along each arm; identify the critical section near the boss.

Select arm section fromZ≥M/sigma allowable; allow for holes, fillets and manufacture.

Size the pin for actual shear planes, bearing contact and pin bending; choose boss length from allowable projected bearing stress.

Check boss net section, retention, clearance, wear and the arm-to-boss transition; proportions alone are insufficient.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Arm thickness,pin diameter પહેલાં FBD solve કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Forces,દરેક armનું moment distribution શોધો;boss પાસે critical section ઓળખો.

Z≥M/sigma allowableથી arm section લો;holes,fillets,manufacture જુઓ.

Pinને actual shear planes,bearing,pin bendingથી size કરો;boss length projected bearing stressથી લો.

Boss net section,retention,clearance,wear,arm-boss transition જુઓ;proportions પૂરતાં નથી.

body.en:
Given and model

ClassI pose shown:W5kN at100mm left, F at500mm right, both downward; allowable bending80MPa, arm h=2b.

Step-by-step solution

  1. F×500=5000×100; F=1000N
  2. Fulcrum reaction=5000+1000=6000N upward
  3. Maximum arm moment=5000×100=500000Nmm
  4. Zrequired=500000/80=6250mm³
  5. For h=2b:bmin=(3M/(2sigma))^(1/3)=21.0858mm
  6. Select b25, h50mm:Z=10416.6667mm³; stress=48MPa

Common mistake / conditions

This uses nominal beam bending; the real boss fillet may require a concentration/fatigue check.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Shown Class I poseમાં W5kN100mm left,F500mm right,બન્ને downward;bending allowable80MPa,arm h=2b.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. F×500=5000×100;F=1000N
  2. Fulcrum reaction=5000+1000=6000N upward
  3. Maximum arm moment=5000×100=500000Nmm
  4. Zrequired=500000/80=6250mm³
  5. For h=2b:bmin=(3M/(2sigma))^(1/3)=21.0858mm
  6. Select b25,h50mm:Z=10416.6667mm³;stress=48MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ nominal beam bending છે;real boss filletમાં concentration/fatigue check જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

Reaction6kN; boss length40mm, each supporting fork15mm, pin20mm, boss outside50mm; allowables bearing50, shear40, bending80MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Boss bearing=6000/(20×40)=7.5MPa
  2. Two-fork bearing=6000/(2×20×15)=10MPa
  3. Pin double shear=6000/(2pi×20²/4)=9.5493MPa
  4. Using uniform boss/triangular fork model:Mpin=(6000/2)(40/4+15/3)=45000Nmm
  5. Pin bending=32×45000/(pi×20³)=57.2958MPa
  6. Simplified boss net tension=6000/[(50−20)×40]=5MPa

Common mistake / conditions

The listed idealised pin/boss checks pass; verify retaining details, actual support geometry and transition stresses before any real design approval.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Reaction6kN;boss length40mm,each fork15mm,pin20mm,boss outside50mm;allowables bearing50,shear40,bending80MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Boss bearing=6000/(20×40)=7.5MPa
  2. Two-fork bearing=6000/(2×20×15)=10MPa
  3. Pin double shear=6000/(2pi×20²/4)=9.5493MPa
  4. Using uniform boss/triangular fork model:Mpin=(6000/2)(40/4+15/3)=45000Nmm
  5. Pin bending=32×45000/(pi×20³)=57.2958MPa
  6. Simplified boss net tension=6000/[(50−20)×40]=5MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Listed idealised checks pass;real approval પહેલાં retaining details,actual support geometry,transition stresses જુઓ.

title.en: 3.2 Leaf spring:define span before using a formula

body.en:
Definition / principle

A leaf spring stores strain energy primarily by bending flat strips.

Understand why

A semi-elliptic assembly has a master leaf with eyes, full-length/graduated leaves, a centre bolt and suitable rebound clips/supports.

A central load bends the stack between end supports; shackles can accommodate length change in the actual mounting.

Applications include vehicle suspensions and selected load-support mechanisms.

Contact friction, nipping, eye stress, load sharing and fatigue affect real springs; simple beam formulas are idealisations.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Leaf spring flat stripsના bendingથી strain energy store કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Semi-elliptic assemblyમાં eyesવાળી master leaf,full-length/graduated leaves,centre bolt,rebound clips/supports હોય.

Central load end supports વચ્ચે stack bend કરે;actual mountingમાં shackles length change accommodate કરે.

Vehicle suspension,selected load-support mechanismsમાં ઉપયોગ.

Contact friction,nipping,eye stress,load sharing,fatigue real springમાં મહત્વનાં;simple formulas idealisations છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

LetS be FULL support span, W total central load, n effective leaves, b width, t thickness, E modulus.

Understand why

For the usual idealised uniform-strength/graded-leaf model:sigma=3WS/(2nbt²), deflection=3WS³/(8Enbt³).

IfL=S/2 is half-span, the same formulas become sigma=3WL/(nbt²), deflection=3WL³/(Enbt³).

A stack of identical full-span strips with uniformI has a different deflection coefficient:delta=WS³/(4Enbt³).Do not mix that model with the graded-leaf coefficient.

Design for both allowable stress and required deflection; check actual leaf arrangement, eyes, clamps and fatigue separately.

Can you use half-span in a full-span formula unchanged?

No. Stress and deflection coefficients must transform consistently.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

S FULL support span,W total central load,n effective leaves,b width,t thickness,E modulus લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Usual idealised uniform-strength/graded-leaf modelમાં sigma=3WS/(2nbt²),deflection=3WS³/(8Enbt³).

L=S/2 half-span હોય તો same formulas sigma=3WL/(nbt²),deflection=3WL³/(Enbt³).

Identical full-span stripsના uniform I stackમાં delta=WS³/(4Enbt³) જુદું coefficient;graded-leaf coefficient સાથે ન ભેળવો.

Allowable stress,required deflection બન્નેથી design કરો;actual arrangement,eyes,clamps,fatigue અલગ જુઓ.

Full-span Formulaમાં Half-span સીધું મૂકી શકાય?

ના.Stress,deflection coefficients consistently બદલવા પડે.

body.en:
Given and model

Idealised graded-leaf model:W3000N, S1000mm, n6, b50mm, E200000MPa; stress limit250MPa, deflection limit40mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. From stress:t≥sqrt[3×3000×1000/(2×6×50×250)]=7.7460mm
  2. From deflection:t≥[3×3000×1000³/(8×200000×6×50×40)]^(1/3)=7.7681mm
  3. Select t8mm:stress=3×3000×1000/(2×6×50×8²)=234.375MPa
  4. Deflection=3×3000×1000³/(8×200000×6×50×8³)=36.6211mm

Common mistake / conditions

Both stated limits pass in this model. This is not fatigue, road-load, clamp or eye certification.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Idealised graded-leaf modelમાં W3000N,S1000mm,n6,b50mm,E200000MPa;stress limit250MPa,deflection limit40mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. From stress:t≥sqrt[3×3000×1000/(2×6×50×250)]=7.7460mm
  2. From deflection:t≥[3×3000×1000³/(8×200000×6×50×40)]^(1/3)=7.7681mm
  3. Select t8mm:stress=3×3000×1000/(2×6×50×8²)=234.375MPa
  4. Deflection=3×3000×1000³/(8×200000×6×50×8³)=36.6211mm

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ modelમાં બન્ને limits pass;fatigue,road-load,clamp,eye certification નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose the correct axis, load and span before substituting numbers.

Understand why

UsingI instead ofZ in sigma=M/Z gives wrong dimensions.

Using a lever input force as the pin load without force balance can under-size the pin.

Counting geometric leaves as equally effective despite different lengths/constraints can invalidate the spring model.

Report selected dimensions and actual verification, not only the theoretical minimum.

Can leaf count alone determine spring rate?

No. Width, thickness, span, modulus and leaf model also enter.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Numbers મૂકતાં પહેલાં correct axis,load,span લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

sigma=M/Zમાં Zની જગ્યાએ I લેવાથી dimensions ખોટાં થાય.

Force balance વગર input forceને pin load માનવાથી pin undersize થાય.

જુદી lengths/constraints છતાં બધી leaves equally effective માનવાથી spring model ખોટું થાય.

ફક્ત theoretical minimum નહિ,selected dimensions,actual verification લખો.

ફક્ત Leaf Countથી Rate નક્કી?

ના.Width,thickness,span,modulus,leaf model પણ જોઈએ.
